name: grunfeld
source: Grunfeld (1958) investment data, via R package plm (Rdatasets mirror)
note: Balanced, 10 firms x 20 years. Below the 20-entity minimum, so no verdict is issued.

name: emplUK
source: Arellano and Bond (1991) UK firm panel, via R package plm (Rdatasets mirror)
note: Unbalanced, 140 firms. Only `sector` is invariant (1 of 5 usable columns), so the documented key scores weak.

name: produc
source: Munnell (1990) US state productivity panel, via R package plm (Rdatasets mirror)
note: Known false negative. The documented key is correct (48 states x 17 years), but only `region` is invariant, 1 of 9 usable columns, below the weak threshold of 0.15. Kept as a calibration marker.

name: gasoline
source: Baltagi and Griffin (1983) OECD gasoline panel, via R package plm (Rdatasets mirror)
note: Balanced, 18 countries x 19 years. Below the 20-entity minimum.
